notes.text: Cook in the stockpot; the beans may need 15 minutes more.

move.title: Eight bowls, costed
move.body: Cuban black bean soup starts with dried beans and a sofrito of onion, green pepper, and garlic, and is puréed smooth with a splash of vinegar at the end. You'll cook a pound of dried beans for 8, build and season the soup, purée it, and work out exactly what each bowl cost from your receipt.

why.title: Soak, or not
why.body: Black beans cook without soaking, but an overnight soak makes them cook faster and more evenly. Either way, pick them over and rinse.

why.title: Sofrito into the beans
why.body: Sautéed onion, pepper, and garlic stirred into the half-cooked beans season them as they finish, rather than sitting on top.

why.title: Vinegar at the end
why.body: A tablespoon or two of vinegar brightens a heavy bean soup. Add it last and taste; acid early slows beans from softening.

why.title: Cost per serving
why.body: Divide each item's price by how much of it the recipe used, add them up, and divide by servings. Dried beans make this one of the cheapest meals you'll cook.

wrong.sign: The beans are still firm after 2 hours
wrong.fix: Old beans. Keep simmering, adding hot water, and test every 15 minutes.
Thin it with hot water or broth, ½ cup at a time.
More salt first, then another splash of vinegar.

quiz.q: Why add the vinegar at the end?
choices: Acid early slows the beans from softening

quiz.q: How do you find cost per serving?
choices: Add up what the recipe used and divide by servings
quiz.explain: Use the share of each package used.

choices: To find small stones or debris

steps.text: Spread the beans on the plate and pick out stones and shriveled beans. Rinse them. Soak overnight in cold water if you can, then drain.
Cover the beans with the water in the stockpot, add the bay leaves, bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered.
Meanwhile, dice the onion and pepper ¼ inch and mince the garlic. Cook them in the oil over medium heat until soft and just golden. Add the cumin and oregano for 30 seconds.
Stir the sofrito and the salt into the beans and simmer until the beans are creamy throughout.

target.look: Five beans in a row creamy all the way through

steps.text: Fish out the bay leaves. Purée with the immersion blender, leaving a little texture. Thin with hot water to a pourable soup.
steps.tip: Keep the blade under the surface or it spatters.

steps.text: Stir in the vinegar and pepper. Taste and correct the salt and acid.
With your receipt, work out the cost of what you used of each ingredient, add them up, and divide by 8. Write it on the recipe.
Serve with sour cream and diced red onion.
